kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · Clin Epigenetics 2024;16:190 · 横断面
title: PAX1/JAM3 Methylation for Triage in HPV 16/18-Infected Women
title_zh: PAX1/JAM3 甲基化在 HPV 16/18 感染女性中的分流
subtitle: 334 HPV16/18+ women — sensitivity 89.0% / specificity 95.3% for CIN2+ (AUC 0.921), ~70% fewer colposcopies
subtitle_zh: 334 例 HPV16/18+ 女性——CIN2+ 灵敏度 89.0% / 特异度 95.3%（AUC 0.921），阴道镜减少约 70%
authors: Fei J, Zhai L, Wang J, Zhu X, et al.
authors_zh: 费菁, 翟凌云, 王静, 朱小琼 等

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: HPV16/18+ women are referred straight to colposcopy by ASCCP/CSCCP guidelines — but many have no lesion; an objective triage could spare them.
Question: can CISCER® PAX1/JAM3 methylation triage HPV16/18+ women for CIN2+ with high accuracy?
Why it matters: HPV16/18 are the highest-risk genotypes — but a methylation triage could halve the colposcopy burden in this group.
bullets_zh: 空白：ASCCP/CSCCP 指南将 HPV16/18+ 女性直接转诊阴道镜——但许多人并无病变；客观分流可使其免于不必要的检查。
问题：CISCER® PAX1/JAM3 甲基化能否高准确度分流 HPV16/18+ 女性的 CIN2+？
意义：HPV16/18 是最高危型别——但甲基化分流可使该人群阴道镜负担减半。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: cross-sectional, single center (Nov 2021–Dec 2022); women referred for colposcopy; histology reference.
Cohort: 245 HPV16+, 77 HPV18+, 12 dual-positive; pathology: 169 normal / 65 CIN1 / 47 CIN2 / 32 CIN3 / 21 cancer.
Methylation: CISCER® (ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 or ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0); Cobas 4800; TCT.
Outcome: CIN2+ triage performance vs cytology and combinations.
bullets_zh: 设计：横断面、单中心（2021.11–2022.12）；转诊阴道镜女性；组织学金标准。
队列：HPV16+ 245 例、HPV18+ 77 例、双阳 12 例；病理：正常 169 / CIN1 65 / CIN2 47 / CIN3 32 / 癌 21。
甲基化：CISCER®（ΔCtPAX1 ≤ 6.6 或 ΔCtJAM3 ≤ 10.0）；Cobas 4800；TCT。
结局：CIN2+ 分流效能 vs 细胞学及联合方案。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: CISCER for CIN2+: sensitivity 89.0% · specificity 95.3% · AUC 0.921 · OR 164.02 — superior to cytology (72.0%/50.4%).
CIN3+: sensitivity 98.1% · specificity 82.9% · AUC 0.905.
All 21 cancers detected (18 SCC + 3 adenocarcinoma); no CIN3+/cancer missed in ≥30 y.
~70% fewer colposcopies: 1.12 referrals per CIN2+ detected; positive post-test CIN2+ risk 89.0%.
bullets_zh: CISCER 检测 CIN2+：灵敏度 89.0% · 特异度 95.3% · AUC 0.921 · OR 164.02——优于细胞学（72.0%/50.4%）。
CIN3+：灵敏度 98.1% · 特异度 82.9% · AUC 0.905。
21 例宫颈癌全部检出（18 鳞癌 + 3 腺癌）；≥30 岁未漏诊任何 CIN3+/癌。
阴道镜减少约 70%：每检出 1 例 CIN2+ 仅 1.12 次转诊；阳性即时 CIN2+ 风险 89.0%。

panels.title: Genotype insight
bullets: HPV16 vs 18: CIN2+ proportion significantly higher in HPV16+ (34.6%) than HPV18+ (16.9%) women.
Dual-type: 12 dual-positive women had the highest lesion burden — all captured by CISCER.
Age safety: in ≥30 y women, no CIN3+/cancer was missed — reassuring for triage-based management.
bullets_zh: HPV16 vs 18：HPV16+ 女性 CIN2+ 比例显著更高（34.6% vs 18+ 的 16.9%）。
双阳型：12 例双阳性女性病变负担最高——CISCER 全部捕获。
年龄安全性：≥30 岁女性未漏诊任何 CIN3+/癌——为基于分流的管理提供安心保障。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Excellent accuracy in HPV16/18+: AUC 0.921 for CIN2+, 98.1% sens for CIN3+ — even in the highest-risk genotype group.
~70% fewer colposcopies with 100% cancer detection — methylation triage refines the direct-referral rule.
bullets_zh: HPV16/18+ 人群中的优异准确性：CIN2+ AUC 0.921，CIN3+ 灵敏度 98.1%——即便在最高危型别组。
阴道镜减少约 70%且癌症检出 100%——甲基化分流优化了直接转诊规则。

kicker_zh: 宫颈癌 · BMC Cancer 2024;24:1514 · 横断面
title: JAM3/PAX1 Methylation in the Diagnosis of HSIL in hrHPV+ Women
title_zh: JAM3/PAX1 甲基化诊断 hrHPV 感染女性 HSIL
subtitle: 276 hrHPV+ women — ΔCtP + TCT + HPV model: sensitivity 91.2% / specificity 87.2%, AUC 0.932
subtitle_zh: 276 例 hrHPV+ 女性——ΔCtP+TCT+HPV 模型：灵敏度 91.2% / 特异度 87.2%，AUC 0.932
authors: Sun D, Shu C, Zeng F, Xu D, Zhao X
authors_zh: 孙丹, 舒畅, 曾飞, 徐大宝, 赵行平

panels.title: Why this study
bullets: Gap: HSIL detection in hrHPV+ women still relies on cytology with limited sensitivity; whether methylation adds diagnostic value over TCT+HPV was unclear.
Question: does JAM3/PAX1 methylation improve HSIL diagnosis alone or in combination with TCT and HPV?
Why it matters: a more accurate HSIL diagnosis means better triage to treatment vs surveillance.
bullets_zh: 空白：hrHPV+ 女性的 HSIL 检出仍依赖灵敏度有限的细胞学；甲基化是否在 TCT+HPV 之外增加诊断价值未明。
问题：JAM3/PAX1 甲基化单独或联合 TCT、HPV 能否提高 HSIL 诊断？
意义：更准确的 HSIL 诊断意味着治疗与随访之间的更好分流。

panels.title: Cohort & methods
bullets: Design: cross-sectional, single center (Aug–Nov 2022); 242 non-HSIL vs 34 HSIL; Xiangya 3rd Hospital.
Methylation: ΔCtP/ΔCtJ (OriginPoly kit); TCT; HPV genotyping (KaiPu GenoArray 21-type).
Analysis: conditional inference trees + ROC for single and combined markers.
Outcome: HSIL diagnostic performance.
bullets_zh: 设计：横断面、单中心（2022.8–11）；非 HSIL 242 例 vs HSIL 34 例；湘雅三医院。
甲基化：ΔCtP/ΔCtJ（起源聚禾试剂盒）；TCT；HPV 分型（凯普 GenoArray 21型）。
分析：条件推断树 + ROC 评估单独与联合标志物。
结局：HSIL 诊断效能。

panels.title: Headline results
bullets: Best model: ΔCtP + TCT + HPV → sensitivity 91.2% · specificity 87.2% · PPV 50.0% · NPV 98.6% · AUC 0.932.
Single markers: ΔCtP AUC 0.867, ΔCtJ 0.841, TCT 0.791, HPV 0.784 — methylation above both.
Decision tree: ΔCtJ > 11.66 → 96.4% non-HSIL; ΔCtP > 10.97 → 99.1% non-HSIL — objective rule-out cut-offs.
Correlation: pathology negatively correlated with ΔCtP (r=−0.447) and ΔCtJ (r=−0.532).
bullets_zh: 最优模型：ΔCtP+TCT+HPV → 灵敏度 91.2% · 特异度 87.2% · PPV 50.0% · NPV 98.6% · AUC 0.932。
单标志物：ΔCtP AUC 0.867、ΔCtJ 0.841、TCT 0.791、HPV 0.784——甲基化均优于两者。
决策树：ΔCtJ > 11.66 → 96.4% 非 HSIL；ΔCtP > 10.97 → 99.1% 非 HSIL——客观排除界值。
相关性：病理与 ΔCtP（r=−0.447）、ΔCtJ（r=−0.532）负相关。

panels.title: Clinical utility
bullets: Rule-out power: NPV 98.6% — a negative methylation-based model makes HSIL highly unlikely.
Independent predictors: ΔCtP, ΔCtJ, ASC-US and HPV16 were independent HSIL risk factors.
Actionable: the decision-tree cut-offs give clinicians simple, objective thresholds for triage.
bullets_zh: 排除能力：NPV 98.6%——基于甲基化的模型阴性时 HSIL 极不可能。
独立预测因子：ΔCtP、ΔCtJ、ASC-US、HPV16 是 HSIL 独立危险因素。
可操作：决策树界值为临床提供简单客观的分流阈值。

takeaway.title: Take-away
bullets: Methylation adds real value: ΔCtP+TCT+HPV reached AUC 0.932 — the most accurate HSIL screening combination.
Objective cut-offs: simple ΔCt thresholds rule out HSIL with 96–99% certainty — practical for daily triage.
bullets_zh: 甲基化带来真实增益：ΔCtP+TCT+HPV 达 AUC 0.932——最准确的 HSIL 筛查组合。
客观界值：简单 ΔCt 阈值以 96–99% 把握排除 HSIL——适合日常分流。
